note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Guinea: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Children may not be employed in any undertaking before sixteen save as apprentices, and the Code names no exception for performing; night work is barred under eighteen; the Code lists entertainment undertakings ('entreprises de spectacles') among those whose list of barred work a ministerial order sets.
figures.applies: Reaches every employment; a child performer under sixteen has no lawful route in the Code (as layer 3 holds).

sources.said: Les enfants ne peuvent être employés dans aucune entreprise avant l’âge de seize ans au moins, sauf comme apprenti tel que prévu aux articles 142.1 et suivants du présent Code.
Le travail de nuit est interdit aux travailleurs de l’un ou l’autre sexe de moins de dix-huit ans.

figures.finding: Majority is fixed at eighteen full years; at that age one is capable of all acts of civil life, and a minor is anyone not yet eighteen.

sources.said: Article 578: La majorité est fixée à 18 ans accomplis ; à cet âge, on est capable de tous les actes de la vie civile. ... Article 512: Le mineur est l'individu de l'un ou de l'autre sexe qui n'a pas encore l'âge de 18 ans accomplis.

figures.finding: An unemancipated minor cannot contract, within the limits the law sets, and the incapacity makes a contract relatively void; a minor may still make alone the everyday acts law or usage allows on normal terms (voidable for mere lesion), and cannot escape commitments made in the exercise of his profession. An employment contract needs the minimum age of sixteen (Labour Code, read earlier). No set-aside of earnings is provided, and nothing distinguishes writing, directing or producing.

value.binding: legal representative acts for an unemancipated minor; professional commitments bind the minor

figures.applies: Code civil 2019, arts 1052-1054; the Labour Code's minimum age (16) in this file's earlier finding.

sources.said: Article 1052 : Sont incapables de contracter, dans la mesure définie par la loi: 1 ° les mineurs non émancipés ; ... Article 1053 : L'incapacité de contracter est une cause de nullité relative. ... Le mineur ne peut se soustraire aux engagements qu'il a pris dans l'exercice de sa profession.
Le contrat de travail ne peut être conclu qu’avec un individu ayant atteint l’âge minimum de Seize ans.

figures.finding: In Guinea, an OHADA state since 21 November 2000, a minor may hold shares only where liability stops at the contribution (a SARL, an SA or SAS, or as a limited partner), never as a partner liable beyond it, and may not trade unless emancipated; the Uniform Act sets no age for a SARL's manager, a natural person, so managing the producer's company takes the civil capacity Guinea's Civil Code gives at eighteen.

value.directorNote: civil capacity under the Code civil (not set by the Uniform Act)

figures.applies: OHADA Uniform Acts, directly applicable in Guinea (Treaty art. 10; ratified 5 May 2000, in force 21 Nov 2000); Code civil 2019 art. 578.

sources.said: Les mineurs et les majeurs incapables ne peuvent être associés d’une société dans laquelle ils seraient tenus des dettes sociales au‐delà de leurs apports.
La société à responsabilité limitée est gérée par une ou plusieurs personnes physiques, associées ou non.
Le mineur, sauf s'il est émancipé, ne peut avoir la qualité de commerçant ni effectuer des actes de commerce.
Les actes uniformes sont directement applicables et obligatoires dans les Etats-Parties, nonobstant toute disposition contraire de droit interne, antérieure ou postérieure.
Article 578: La majorité est fixée à 18 ans accomplis ; à cet âge, on est capable de tous les actes de la vie civile.

figures.finding: No performers' or screen guild with membership rules was found in Guinea (artists were still discussing forming a union in 2025); the Labour Code lets any worker, formal or informal, without distinction, found or join a union, so a young person lawfully at work (sixteen and over) may join; a union's leaders must enjoy their civil rights.
figures.applies: Code du travail (Loi L/2014/072/CNT), arts 322.1, 322.2, 322.4 (FAOLEX copy); Le360 Afrique, Sept 2025, on a union being discussed (searched 2026-11-01).
